note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Dzurinda's broad coalition of SDK, SDĽ, SMK and SOP, with Mečiar's HZDS as the largest opposition party), not measured data. Influence reflects a country preparing for EU accession (approved by referendum in 2003), an influential Catholic Church, a Hungarian minority party in government and moderately strong trade unions.

interest_groups.note: The Catholic Church; KDH sat in the governing coalition within SDK.
The Hungarian minority's party (SMK) was in government; also includes the Roma.
